description: Create, replace or change one resource; get <type> shows what each takes, with an example. value is the whole resource, as get answers it: a frame { code: "<JSX>" } or, as JSON, { name, root }; a component { description, props, tsx }; a source or table its fields. edits change part of it: [{ old, new }] replaces text in its code (copy old from what get answers: code is stored formatted), or an object is merged into its fields. One layer changes alone at its own path: frame/<id>/<layer> with edits { props: { … } }. Every set is checked as the studio checks it; a refused set changes nothing: read the error, fix, send again. The answer has the path it is stored at, its new revision, what changed, and draftRevision (the draft as it is now: what publish takes). (In a scene's draft; scene: its id.) Changing a resource that exists needs its `revision`, from the answer that read it ("*" overwrites whatever is there, on purpose); without it the answer is REVISION_REQUIRED. A new path needs none.

field.description: Which text, when the resource has more than one (a web source's styles); default: its code

new.description: The text that takes old's place; empty deletes it

old.description: Text as it is now (copied from what get answered); it matches ignoring whitespace and must match once

edits.description: Part of the resource: text replacements in its code (a frame's code, a component's tsx, a script), or an object merged into its fields (a JSON merge patch; null removes a field)

path.description: What to write, e.g. frame/intro, source/data/headlines, component/LowerThird

revision.description: The revision get or the last set answered (of this path, or of the frame a layer is in): the set is refused (CONFLICT, with currentRevision) if it changed since. Send it whenever the path exists — "*" replaces whatever is there, knowingly; over the MCP a write to an existing path without one is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED). A new path needs none

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

value.description: The whole resource: a field left out is cleared (to change part of it, send edits)

name: scene_set

draftRevision.description: The draft as it is now: what publish_scene takes

revision.description: Its new revision: send it with the next change to it

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Change a scene's draft
